info.name: Iteration 02 — Professional Redesign · asset smoke
info.description:
Smoke suite for the John Rey Seguma portfolio (React 18 + Vite static SPA).

This project has NO backend and NO API of its own, so this collection verifies that the
PRODUCTION BUILD and every asset the redesigned page references are actually served.

HOW TO RUN
1. cd <repo root>
2. npm run build
3. npm run preview        (note the port it prints, e.g. 4173)
4. Import this collection + smoke.postman_environment.json, set {{baseUrl}} to the
   printed origin (scheme + host + port only, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4173).
5. Run the collection. Every request must pass.

ASSUMPTIONS
- {{basePath}} is /john-rey-portfolio (vite.config.js `base`). Leave it as-is.
- No seeded data or credentials are needed; all assets are static files under public/.
- The JS/CSS bundle filenames are content-hashed; request 01 parses index.html and
  stores them in collection variables, so the suite survives a rebuild.

WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER: visual layout and in-page interactions (tabs, disclosures,
lightbox). Use qa/manual-checklist.md in a browser for those.
